description: This file defines interfaces related to value type serialization within the Orleans.Serialization framework, including a generic interface for serializing value types and a marker interface for serializers.

classes.name: IValueSerializer<T>
classes.description: Interface for serializing a specific value type T, extending the marker interface IValueSerializer.

classes.name: IValueSerializer
classes.description: Marker interface for value type serializers.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T using a buffer writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into a value of type T from a reader.
